title: Plant Manager
text:
Judge Direct Placement is seeking a Plant Manager in Springfield, IL area! The Plant Manager will provide leadership across all visions of the plant while fostering a high-performance engaged work force.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for plant operations, including safety, quality, production, maintenance, and supply chain functions
* Ensure consistent and reliable execution of production schedules across multiple lines and shifts
* Drive continuous improvement in Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), productivity, and cost efficiency
* Uphold high standards for product quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence
* Lead capital projects and oversee equipment performance and facility reliability initiatives
* Implement Lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement programs to reduce waste and enhance efficiency
* Champion process optimization efforts and drive initiatives to reduce scrap and improve yield
* Foster a safety-first culture and ensure full compliance with all regulatory and environmental requirements
* Lead programs that prioritize the safety and well-being of employees, customers, and the community
* Ensure strict adherence to quality standards and customer specifications
* Identify operational risks proactively and implement mitigation strategies
* Manage plant performance against financial and operational targets, ensuring accountability at all levels
* Develop and execute plans to optimize cost structure and improve overall operational performance
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement corrective actions to drive results
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning processes
* Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams of hourly and salaried employees
* Promote a culture of engagement, accountability, and continuous learning
* Coach and mentor supervisors and frontline leaders to strengthen leadership capabilities
* Drive employee retention, development, and succession planning initiatives
* Maintain strong employee relations and a positive, inclusive work environment
* Align plant operations with corporate strategy and cross-functional objectives
* Communicate effectively across all levels, from frontline employees to executive leadership
* Serve as the primary representative of the plant within the broader organization
* Encourage collaboration and teamwork across all functional areas

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations or Business
* Proven leadership experience in a manufacturing setting
* Proven success managing high-volume, multi-line production
* Experience implementing lean manufacturing, CI systems, and problem-solving methods
* Proven ability to lead, develop and retain both hourly & salary employees
* Hands on leadership, with strong floor presence

**Benefits Information**

Full-Time candidates hired for this position are eligible to receive the following benefits:

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Retirement
* Paid Time Off

Health and Retirement Benefits are not available for part-time candidates for this position at this time. All hired candidates will receive Paid Time Off in accordance with applicable law and company policy.

degree.text: Bachelor's degree in engineering, Operations or Business
